ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Mechanical Engineer to design, build, and own the mechanical side of our robotic actuator dynamometer and test infrastructure. This role combines precision mechanical design with hands-on lab work. You will take robotic actuator test infrastructure from requirements and analysis through CAD, fabrication, assembly, commissioning, and iteration, partnering closely with electrical and software engineers to deliver safe, flexible, high-uptime test cells.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

- Own the mechanical architecture of dynamometer and actuator test cells, including frames, bases, load paths, alignment, guarding, and serviceability.

Responsibilities

As our PostgreSQL DBA, you will be the go-to engineer for everything data-layer: index and schema design on multi-terabyte tables, query optimization for application teams, connection pooling, upgrades, and migrations. Own day-to-day PostgreSQL operations across all production data centers: index creation on large/partitioned tables, query-plan analysis, schema reviews, data migrations.

Partner with application teams on data-model decisions - design, partitioning, retention, consolidation vs. standalone clusters - and push back with data when a design won't scale.

Operate and tune Aurora PostgreSQL: parameter groups, replicas, failover behavior, capacity planning.

Run and evolve our PgBouncer connection-pooling layer.

Turn manual runbooks into released, repeatable automation: seamless upgrade, switchover, database/user provisioning, grants management (Terraform + Ansible).

Drive incident response and RCAs for database-related issues, and land the follow-up actions.

•
Maintain and improve database observability (postgres_exporter, VictoriaMetrics dashboards and alerts).

•
Take part in the team's duty rotation handling developer requests, with protected focus time off-duty.

Requirements

Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills

•
5+ years of hands-on operational PostgreSQL experience (DBA / database reliability role).

•
Strong command of query plans, indexing strategy, and performance work on multi-TB tables.

•
Production experience with managed PostgreSQL (Aurora or RDS) and a clear-eyed view of its constraints.

•
Working proficiency with Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code practices; comfortable in Linux.

•
Experience with connection pooling (PgBouncer or similar) in production.

•
Practical experience with logical replication, major-version upgrades, and low-downtime migration techniques.

•
Scripting ability (Bash, Python or GO) and an automation-first mindset.
